name: Lianhua
source: The true identity of the mysterious spirit maiden. She was the past girlfriend of Yunshan during high school, before her tragic death through a failed medical procedure meant to treat her brain cancer. When Yunshan comes back to Tangyin, Lianhua materializes into this world out of concern for him, but realizes that he already has someone else by his side: Jingxuan.
